question: LAPTOP FDV above $1B one day after launch?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fully Diluted Valuation of the LAPTOP token is greater than the specified value 1 day after launch. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The token referenced in this market is LAPTOP, the token announced by Hunter Biden for launch on Base, as identified by the token's official channels (https://x.com/Laptoptoken) and confirmed by Hunter Biden or his official representatives.

The token must be actively and publicly tradable to be considered a launch.

The FDV will be determined using the total token supply multiplied by the token price.

"1 day after launch" is defined as 4:00 PM ET on the calendar day following launch. The resolution source for this market is the most liquid price source available. If the LAPTOP token has not launched by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".
research:
I couldn't open any page directly: every fetch was refused by the proxy. Everything below comes from search-result summaries, so treat exact figures and timestamps as unverified. I left out anything dated after 2026-09-09.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria name no specific feed, only "the most liquid price source available." FDV is total supply times price. Total supply is reported as 1 billion, so $1B FDV means about $1.00 per token. [crowdfundinsider](https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/?p=308246), [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/?p=21419)
- Liquidity is split across an official Aerodrome Slipstream pool (about $83K USDC) and a Uniswap pool (about $380K USDC). A Base USDC/LAPTOP Uniswap V3 pool page shows a creation date of 2026-09-07. [dexpaprika pool](https://dexpaprika.com/base/pool/0x7702411b3893ea4f6ab96c50231cfec65448ab9f), [The Defiant](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-laptop-falls-99-percent-three-hours-trump-valuation)
- Copycat tokens with the same ticker exist on Base and other chains, so aggregators may be tracking the wrong contract. [The Defiant copycats](https://thedefiant.io/newsletter/defi-daily/hunter-bidens-memecoin-already-has-14-copycats), [GoPlus via nitter](https://nitter-canary.kareem.one/GoPlusSecurity)
- I could not load the Polymarket page or a live price page to give a current value.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-09: LAPTOP launched on Base. Based on the timeline below, launch seems to have come after this question closes at 07:58 UTC, so forecasters at close would not have seen trading yet. The resolution snapshot is 4:00 PM ET on 2026-09-10 (20:00 UTC).
- 2026-09-09: Arkham data shows the price hit $190.81 about two minutes after launch, a "FDV" of about $144B, with only about $48K in the pool. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/377783/hunter-biden-laptop-meme-coin-crashes)
- 2026-09-09: The Defiant's timeline:
  - First 5-minute prints were $247.55 on Aerodrome and $225.06 on Uniswap V4.
  - By 15:20 UTC the price was $1.90, and $1.93 at 15:25 UTC per CoinGecko, about $1.9B FDV.
  - The Defiant calls the opening highs not tradable prices. [The Defiant](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-laptop-falls-99-percent-three-hours-trump-valuation)
- 2026-09-09: In the afternoon (ET) the token traded around $1.97, down about 99% from the high. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/377783/hunter-biden-laptop-meme-coin-crashes)
- So on launch day the token was trading above the $1/$1B line, but it was falling steeply on thin liquidity. Nothing settles the question yet.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-09: Hunter Biden blamed the market maker, which he says put in only $5,000 of liquidity in the first 30 seconds, and "snipers." He said "nobody on our side sold" and that he had not made "a single dollar." [Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/news/hunter-biden-denies-profiting-memecoin-laptop-crash), [Fox Business](https://foxbusiness.com/politics/hunter-biden-lashes-out-after-laptop-meme-coin-collapse)
- 2026-09-09: The team said it would put 4M tokens (0.4% of supply) into Aerodrome pool incentives. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/377783/hunter-biden-laptop-meme-coin-crashes)
- 2026-09-09: Bubblemaps data shows 15,206 wallets traded. 11,311 lost under $1,000 and only 363 made over $1,000. Arkham and Lookonchain flagged large token movements before launch and early selling by the market maker. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/377783/hunter-biden-laptop-meme-coin-crashes)
- 2026-09-07: CoinDesk reported the launch plan, including an airdrop aimed at people who lost money on TRUMP. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/07/hunter-biden-is-launching-a-memecoin-named-after-his-laptop)
- Tokenomics from pre-launch reports:
  - 30% to founders, locked 6 months then vested over 2 years.
  - 30% burned or released depending on 30 real-world events.
  - About 20% for airdrops: 10% unlocked at launch through Phoenix Veritas Foundation claims, 10% held back. [crowdfundinsider](https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/?p=308246), [AirdropAlert](https://airdropalert.com/airdrops/hunter-biden-laptop-memecoin/)
  - Only a small share of supply is freely tradable early on, which helps a high FDV last.

## 4. Base rates
- Celebrity and political memecoins usually peak within minutes and then lose most of their value over the first day. TRUMP (Jan 2025) was the exception: it held a very high FDV for days. I didn't find a systematic dataset on how often a celebrity token is above $1B FDV 24 hours after launch.
- In this case the price fell about 99% from the peak within about three hours, but was still near $1.9B FDV mid-afternoon UTC. To finish below the line by 20:00 UTC on 2026-09-10, it would need to drop roughly another 50% from about $1.90. That kind of move is common for a memecoin on its first day.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-08: Polymarket "$LAPTOP FDV above ___ one day after launch" priced $1B at about 9% and $100M at about 80%, per an Odaily newsflash. [Odaily](https://www.odaily.news/en/newsflash/516246), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/laptop-fdv-above-one-day-after-launch)
- Pre-launch, a Bundle piece said Polymarket priced the $500M bucket at about 1 in 4. [Bundle](https://www.bundle.app/en/finance/hunter-bidens-laptop-is-set-to-print-a-phantom-fdv-polymarket-prices-the-500m-bucket-at-1-in-4-6EA6BDBC-46C4-4150-BD86-98B03DAAA878)
- 2026-09-09: Tech Insider says the $1B contract rose to about 36%, up roughly 24 points in 24 hours. The time of day is unclear. [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/?p=21419)
- A CoinGape article reported $1B at 17%, $750M at 40% and $500M at 67%, with the token near $0.84 (about $835M FDV). I could not confirm its date, and it may come after the cutoff. [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-laptop-meme-coin-hold-a-100m-fdv-one-day-after-launch-odds-reach-96/)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-10, 20:00 UTC (4 PM ET): the FDV snapshot.
- Before then, things that could move the price:
  - The 10% airdrop unlocked at launch, which recipients may sell.
  - The extra Aerodrome liquidity incentives.
  - Possible exchange listings.
  - Continued fallout from the rug-pull accusations.
- Ambiguity to watch: which pool counts as "most liquid," and whether a price feed reports a lower circulating or total supply. Some aggregators show about 878.5M or 985M instead of 1B, which shifts the dollar-per-token threshold.
